Izzi Dame Wins WWE NXT Women’s North American Championship

⌾ Felix Upton | ▣ November 24, 2026 | ◷ 2 min read
iPhone App Android App Send News Tip Leave Comment
Follow

Instaread

ZARIA’s run as NXT Women’s North American Champion has come to an end. During WWE NXT on November 24, 2026, Izzi Dame defeated ZARIA to capture the championship in the main event.

ZARIA dominated the early portion of the match, using her power to toss Dame around the ring. However, Dame turned things around by targeting ZARIA’s lower back, using the steel ring post to inflict more damage.

Both women traded several near falls before Dame resorted to dirty tactics, poking ZARIA in the eye and sending her into the ring post. Dame even attempted to use the championship belt as a weapon before the referee intervened. ZARIA nearly retained her championship after connecting with a spear and an F5, but Dame managed to get her foot on the bottom rope to break the pinfall.

1/1 Skip Ad Continue watchingafter the adVisit Advertiser websiteGO TO PAGE

The turning point came when Dame sent ZARIA into the steel steps before delivering a missile dropkick that sent the champion crashing through the barricade. Dame then brought ZARIA back into the ring and connected with the Dame Over to secure the pinfall and become the new NXT Women’s North American Champion.

Izzi Dame now has championship gold heading into the John Cena Classic, while ZARIA is left picking up the pieces after losing her title. Whether ZARIA gets another shot at Dame remains to be seen.

What do you think about Izzi Dame dethroning ZARIA to become the new NXT Women’s North American Champion? Let us know your thoughts in the comments below.

WWE Announces Several Matches and Segments for December 1 NXT

⌾ H Jenkins | ▣ November 24, 2026 | ◷ 1 min read
iPhone App Android App Send News Tip Leave Comment
Follow
Us To Stay Connected With Our Updates
蝶 Connect with us on Bluesky →

WWE is already stacking the lineup for next week’s episode of NXT. During WWE NXT on November 24, 2026, the company announced two matches and a major face-to-face confrontation for the December 1 episode.

Zilla Fatu, EK Prosper, Tristan Angels and Kam Hendrixx will compete in a Fatal Four-Way match, with the winner earning an opportunity against Jackson Drake for the NXT North American Championship at NXT TLC.

Mason Rook will also come face-to-face with NXT Champion Grayson Waller after securing his championship opportunity by defeating Shiloh Hill and laying out Waller with a powerbomb. Additionally, Daga, Lexis King and Dion Lennox will square off in a Triple Threat match.

Here is the updated lineup for December 1:

  • Zilla Fatu vs. EK Prosper vs. Tristan Angels vs. Kam Hendrixx — NXT North American Championship #1 Contender’s Match
  • Mason Rook and Grayson Waller face-to-face
  • Daga vs. Lexis King vs. Dion Lennox

With NXT TLC around the corner, next week’s show will determine Jackson Drake’s next challenger while giving Rook and Waller another opportunity to get their hands on each other before their championship showdown.

What do you think of next week’s WWE NXT lineup? Who should earn the North American Championship opportunity at NXT TLC? Let us know in the comments below.
